race.comment: DOUGAL MCKEEN (7) was ridden with more aggression last start and the move paid off when he staged a form reversal to get the cash over 1400m at Mt Gambier. Building a nice record at this trip and with the race fitness edge on many key rivals he can add another win today. SIR PANAMA (3) returns after a 137-day absence. Had a strong SP profile right through last prep but failed to salute. Boasts an outstanding record of four wins and two placings from seven runs over this course and distance. Must be respected. CHARLESFORT (4) was back in form last time out, beaten under a length over 1550m at Bordertown. Comes back in trip but the reapplication of blinkers should offset that. One of the key contenders. Distance specialist NAVY GOLD (5) is back after a 27-week spell. Has trialled twice recently and looks set to make an immediate impact. OUTCASTER (12) is first-up off a 24-week spell. Placed three from five when fresh so keep her in mind.
